```{R, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
# prettify dataset
library(stringr)
mtcars$brand <- word(rownames(mtcars), 1)
#mtcars$brand <- sapply(rownames(mtcars), function(x){ x[, 6]})
```


# Geoms



## Subtask 1

... and a figure!

% format as gggrid?
```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_bar(aes(x=wt))
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_point(aes(x=wt, y=mpg))
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_boxplot(aes(as.factor(cyl), wt)) +
	geom_point(aes(x=as.factor(cyl), y=wt, col=mpg, shape=brand))
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_label(aes(x=hp, y=cyl, label=brand))
	#geom_text(aes(x=hp, y=cyl, label=brand), check_overlap=TRUE)
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(iris) +
	geom_spoke(aes(x=0, y=0, col=Species, angle=Petal.Width/Petal.Length, radius=Petal.Length))
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_bar(aes(cyl))
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_bar(aes(cyl)) +
	coord_polar(theta="x")
```
